operative-discipline-grants-stock.head: e0fd3ea1ae382b7ed4e3decd4d822d654ea7731a
operative-discipline-grants-stock.scope: Stock PacketLog pr462 shows grant membership for 118→1119, 131→1115, 283→1120 and 285→1122 at 141. Each sends its individual removal and restoration after the parent cycle. The four pre-seeded grants activate natively in the same run.
